TITLE: At least 19 dead in stampede at Kolkata Hindu festival | News | Al Jazeera

A seven-year-old girl was among at least 19 people killed in a stampede during a Hindu festival in Kolkata, India. Heavy rain and a sudden crowd surge triggered the deadly crush, leaving another 25 people injured.
